svg.aria-label: Five initializations, step sizes, and methods on the fully known target energy. Each shows 128 final states after 2,000 steps and the first chain trajectory. Title TV uses all second-half states. Final panel shows exact target quadrant masses in lower-left, lower-right, upper-right, upper-left order.
